messages:
Alyssa (AE): Hey team, OxbridgeData POC is blocked — they need to pin model for UK-only data residency but when they try to pin 'redwood-3b-v2' in the eu-uk region the API returns 404/Unavailable. Customer is asking for a Dedicated trial quote too. Can someone triage?
Marcus (Solutions Eng): Sorry to hear that. Has the customer tried the API call with region header?
Tom (OxbridgeData): Tried two ways, same result. From their logs:  
```
POST /v1/deployments/pin
Host: api.redwood.ai (region: eu-uk)
Body: {"model":"redwood-3b-v2"}
-> 404 {"error":"model_not_available_in_region"}
```
Alyssa (AE): They also hit 429 when trying fallback routes earlier. 
Priya (Eng-Platform): On it. Can you confirm the exact model id they used (with sha)? sometimes pin mapping changed after a deprec.
Tom (OxbridgeData): It's exactly 'redwood-3b-v2' — Sales contract needs the 3b family specifically. 
Marcus (Solutions Eng): Quick note: 'redwood-3b-v2' was deprecated in some regions last quarter; EU-UK may not have the backed replica. We can offer 'redwood-3b-quant' as a compat fallback but need to confirm accuracy impact.
Alyssa (AE): Customer insists on same architecture; legal questionnaire requires explicit model family. They won't accept quantized approximation without eval.
Priya (Eng-Platform): OK. I'm checking internal routing — @Jon (Oncall Bot) can you pull the region model inventory for eu-uk?
Jon (Oncall Bot): Inventory lookup: 
- redwood-3b-v1: available
- redwood-3b-v2: unavailable (no replicas in eu-uk)
- redwood-3b-quant: available (q8)

Jon (Oncall Bot): Recent change: automatic deprecation replication to eu-uk failed on 2026-01-12 due to capacity limits. Ticket INFRA-6842 created.
R&D-Infra: Confirming, we prioritized eu-west over eu-uk during last replication window. Can schedule replication but needs approval for capacity.
Marcus (Solutions Eng): Two threads to run in parallel: 1) short-term workaround for the POC (routing/fallback + eval) 2) long-term solution (replicate model to eu-uk or grant dedicated trial).
Alyssa (AE): Customer asks about pricing for Dedicated trial (1 month, pinned model). Can Legal sign off quick for data residency exception if we host in eu-west for this POC?
Legal-Bot: Legal note: data residency exceptions require a JMLA addendum and security review. For trials, we can propose a controlled exception with limited retention and BAA language; will need Sales + AE to approve. Typical turnaround 3-5 business days.
Priya (Eng-Platform): Immediate technical options: 
- Option A (fastest): Route POC traffic to eu-west where model exists and enable prefix-limited caching. Must get customer consent for slight region change.
- Option B (compliance path): Provision a Dedicated trial in eu-uk with a temporary model replica — needs infra capacity and Sponsor approval. ETA 2-5 days if capacity cleared.
- Option C (compat): Use redwood-3b-quant in eu-uk and run quick eval set to show parity (may take 24-48h).
Tom (OxbridgeData): We cannot move to eu-west unless we get written approval from our legal/compliance team. Option C might be acceptable if you supply eval results.
Marcus (Solutions Eng): I'll coordinate the eval. Can you share a 50-prompt representative set? We can run A/B with v2 in eu-west vs quant in eu-uk and provide a diff report.
Alyssa (AE): I'll ask Tom for the prompt set and forward Legal's requirements. Also need a Dedicated trial quote — finance, can we get a quick ballpark?
Marcus (Solutions Eng): Ballpark: 1-month dedicated (r5-equivalent) with single pinned model + 0.5TB egress buffer ~ $12k month for trial (discounted). I'll confirm with finance.
Priya (Eng-Platform): For the infra ticket, I'm requesting a one-off replica to eu-uk under INFRA-6842; need capacity approval. R&D-Infra, please comment on required GPU nodes.
R&D-Infra: We need 2x A10-class nodes configured for model shards; lead-time depends on cluster scheduler. If Sales approves cost/time, we can prioritize.
Tom (OxbridgeData): We'll share the eval set today. If quant looks good, may accept. If not, we need the dedicated replica. Time-sensitive — pilot starts next Tue.
Alyssa (AE): Action items pinned: 
- Marcus: run eval A/B once prompt set arrives (ETA 24-48h).
- Priya + R&D-Infra: estimate node provisioning time & cost for 1-month replica (ETA 1 business day).
- Legal-Bot: draft exception language for routing to eu-west for POC (ETA 72h).
- Alyssa: collect prompt set + confirm customer's approval for region fallback if needed.
Marcus (Solutions Eng): I'll also include token-level latency/cost comparison and sample diffs in the report.
Priya (Eng-Platform): I'll keep this thread updated. If anyone needs to escalate, ping @oncall-eng.
Alyssa (AE): Thanks all — Tom I'll follow up with a calendar slot for the handoff once Marcus has the eval plan. :thumbsup:
Tom (OxbridgeData): Thanks — appreciate the fast responses.
Marcus (Solutions Eng): one more note: if we end up provisioning Dedicated trial, recommend pinning to a model snapshot id (sha-xxxxx) not just the friendly name to avoid future deprecations.
Alyssa (AE): noted. Closing loop here for now, will reopen if blockers remain. :white_check_mark:
